results.name: Mount Takao (高尾山)
results.principal_activities: Hiking (multiple trails, 2.4–3.8 km), cable car / chair lift, temple visit (Yakuo-in), autumn leaf viewing, natural hot spring

results.name: Mount Mitake (御岳山)
results.approximate_travel_time: ~1 h 15 min from Shinjuku (JR Chūō → Ōme Line + cable car)
results.principal_activities: Hiking, Rock Garden trail (mossy rocks, waterfalls, streams), birdwatching, seasonal wildflowers

results.name: Okutama (奥多摩)
results.approximate_travel_time: ~1 h 30 min – 2 h from Shinjuku (JR Chūō → Ōme Line)
results.principal_activities: Hiking along Tama River gorge, Lake Okutama walks, limestone caves (Nippara), river swimming, hot springs

results.name: Hakone – Lake Ashi & Owakudani
results.approximate_travel_time: ~2 h from Shinjuku (Odakyū Romancecar to Hakone-Yumoto + local transport)
results.principal_activities: Lake cruise, Hakone Ropeway with Mt. Fuji views, Owakudani volcanic valley, lakeside hiking, hot springs

results.name: Lake Kawaguchiko (河口湖) – Fuji Five Lakes
results.approximate_travel_time: ~2 h from Shinjuku (Fuji Excursion limited express or highway bus)
results.principal_activities: Mt. Fuji viewing, panoramic ropeway, lakeside cycling, sightseeing boat, seasonal flower parks (shibazakura, lavender)

results.name: Nikko National Park – Kegon Falls & Lake Chūzenji
results.approximate_travel_time: ~2 h from Asakusa (Tōbu Railway) or Shinkansen + local bus
results.principal_activities: Kegon Falls viewing, Lake Chūzenji lakeside walks, Akechidaira ropeway, forest hiking, hot springs

results.name: Kamakura Trails
results.approximate_travel_time: ~1 h from Tokyo Station (JR Yokosuka Line)
results.principal_activities: Ten-en Hiking Course (temple-to-temple ridge walk), coastal walks, beach strolling, seasonal foliage
